model.name: TEMPORAL_ARROW_SHAPE_NOT_CAUSAL_ARROW
equations: F: r<d, R: r>d, S: r=d; F/R banks exact time mirrors
model.evaluation: Two symmetric disjoint train/test masks; fit nonnegative amplitude and intercept on train, select minimum train MSE per family, score held-out. Swap folds; normalize by held-out constant fitted on train. No per-case fitting on test. Tie-break symmetric on observable scores; no causal inference from orientation.

decision.meaning: Fixed engineering thresholds, not calibrated scientific false-positive rates. If inadequate fit or insufficient margin, abstain.

exam.truth: Morphology labels for defined shapes only; ordinary_causal_slow_rise has identical observable generator as slow_rise_fast_decay and explicit ordinary cause. two_pulse, noise and clipped have no single-template truth; report output distributions, no forced labels.

gates.mirror: Every case and exact reverse must have D opposite within 1e-10, Q same, and mirrored decisions; no actual veto.
gates.strong: Each seed fast/slow strong 32+32: at least 85% correctly oriented including abstentions as noncorrect; no more than 5% wrong orientation. Symmetric case at least 80% abstain. If failure report HOLD, no threshold tuning.
gates.identifiability: Paired identical observations with different causal labels produce identical decisions; no physical claim, ever.
gates.replay: Fit each direction on observed outside central gap, reconstruct hidden points, evaluate against sealed generator truth; competing models remain possible; compare to interpolation baseline; report all errors, not claim reconstruction uniquely identifies source.
gates.native: Re-execute native frozen original scorer on all 288 identical synthetic cubes; compare hashes and scores to R1.2A receipt, apply separate arrow scorer to center-band excess envelope without changing native decision. No claim of time direction for original cube labels.
gates.real: Reacquire hash-matched GWOSC H1/L1 raw strain; fixed offline bandpass 35–350 Hz and centered 32ms RMS; extract fixed event window plus ten background windows; compare D and mirror symmetry, no physical signaling inference. CHIME catalog has no time waveform; no fabricated radio observations.

inverse.egg: Distinct latent histories generate same observed terminal state; use two different admissible hidden input sequences with identical endpoint under linear transition. Replay each; retain both.
inverse.forecast: Forward replay is an out-of-observation reconstruction test, not prospective prediction.

spiral.origin_prime: State enriched only by measured results or explicit blockers, hashes exclude turn number; preserve ambiguity and parent chain.

scientific_ceiling: A temporal asymmetry is not physical retrocausality. H4/H5 remain HOLD: unknown carrier coupling and no independent paired UAP/carrier observations. No real radio data or third-party blind holdout. Native production unchanged.
